comment: Town regulars (spawn true) and story characters placed by chapters (spawn false). Colours are hex without 0x. Greetings vary with the Code tier.

npcs.name: Doc Vega
npcs.greetLow: Hm. Try not to lean on anything patented.
npcs.greetMid: Cole. The workshop's holding together, mostly on spite.
npcs.greetHigh: Ah, the famous Cole Calloway. Wipe your boots.

npcs.name: Preacher Boone
npcs.greetLow: The book says judge not, so I won't. Out loud.
npcs.greetHigh: There he is. Proof that patience moves mountains, or at least banks.

npcs.name: Newt
npcs.greetLow: I'm not s'posed to talk to outlaws. Lucky I never listen.
npcs.greetMid: Cole! I've been practising my hawk call. Wanna hear?
npcs.greetHigh: Cole! Everyone's talking about you. I said I knew you FIRST.

npcs.name: Sheriff Bly
npcs.greetLow: Don't make me do paperwork, Calloway. We'd both regret it.
npcs.greetMid: Mm. Warm one today. Crime takes a siesta, I find.
npcs.greetHigh: Folk hero, they say. Long as heroing stays quiet, we're square.

npcs.name: Mabel
npcs.greetHigh: Well, if it isn't the best customer honesty ever had.

npcs.name: The Kestrel
npcs.greetLow: Mr Calloway. Still on my list.
npcs.greetHigh: Mr Calloway. You make my job very confusing.

npcs.name: Cornelius Vane
npcs.greetLow: Ah, the vandal. Do admire the statues on your way out.
npcs.greetMid: Do I know you? I know everyone worth knowing.
npcs.greetHigh: The famous outlaw. My publicist says I shouldn't be seen with you.

npcs.name: Marshal Reyes
npcs.greetLow: I've read your file. Twice. It's a strange file.
npcs.greetHigh: Calloway. The file didn't do you justice.
